descriptionChirho: General sense of performing an action, doing a deed, or carrying out an activity, corresponding to Arabic فَعَلَ/يَفْعَلُ and Korean 하다/행하다.
To fashion, fabricate, or bring something into existence, corresponding to Arabic صَنَعَ/يَصْنَعُ and Korean 만들다.
Causative sense of making someone or something become a certain state, or causing an effect or condition, corresponding to Arabic جَعَلَ and Korean 하게 하다.
To produce fruit or yield results, used of trees, vines, and metaphorical productivity, corresponding to Arabic أَثْمَرَ and Korean 맺다, Swahili kuzaa.
To designate or install someone in a role or office, corresponding to Arabic أَقَامَ and Korean 세우다/임명하다.
To observe or celebrate a feast, festival, or religious practice, corresponding to Korean 지키다 and Swahili kusherehekea.
To spend or pass a period of time in a place or activity, corresponding to Arabic قَضَى and Korean 보내다.
To work or toil at a task, corresponding to Arabic عَمِلَ and Korean 일하다.
To commit a sin, crime, or wrongdoing, corresponding to Arabic عَمِلَ (negative) and Korean 저지르다.
To compose or produce a written account or narrative, corresponding to Arabic صَنَعَ (literary context) and Korean 기록하다.
To count, consider, or regard something in a certain way, corresponding to Arabic أَجْعَلُ (evaluative) and Korean 여기다.
